mechanism_narrative: Rising consumer demand, proxied by HOUST, leads to higher corporate earnings expectations and thus a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return.
failure_condition: Significant negative 20-day forward returns when HOUST shows persistent upward momentum but SPX declines, with no change in earnings expectations (IC < -0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in employment (PAYEMS) coincides with reduced labor market frictions and accelerates corporate investment, driving positive 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: No significant return when PAYEMS spikes but unemployment falls less than expected (IC < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the 12-month change in FEDFUNDS turns positive (signaling rate cuts), discount rates compress and equity valuations become more attractive, producing a 5-day positive S&P 500 forward return.
failure_condition: 5-day returns negative when FEDFUNDS crosses zero upward but macroeconomic news is negative (e.g., CPI surprise high).

mechanism_narrative: A surge in industrial production (INDPRO) suggests expanding supply capacity, reducing near-term output gaps and prompting positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: No return when INDPRO spikes but inflation (CPIAUCSL) rises simultaneously (IC > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive months of rising consumer prices (CPIAUCSL) erode real income, but if the acceleration is unexpected, it triggers a short-term positive S&P 500 5-day forward return as investors anticipate future deflation.
failure_condition: 5-day returns negative when CPIAUCSL accelerates but SPX declines (IC < -0.2).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in unemployment (PAYEMS) combined with rising labor force participation (implied via UNRATE dynamics) signals a strong labor market, producing a 60-day positive S&P 500 forward return.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS monthly change > -1000 and UNRATE monthly change > -0.2%
failure_condition: No return when labor indicators strengthen but corporate profits (GDPC1) show no improvement (IC < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising), the S&P 500 exhibits a short-term negative 20-day forward return as capital flows reallocate from equities to safer assets.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS rises but macroeconomic news is positive (IC > -0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A prolonged decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below trend suggests structural supply constraints, leading to a 5-day negative S&P 500 forward return as investors anticipate slower growth.
failure_condition: 5-day return not negative when INDPRO recovers unexpectedly (IC < -0.2).
